newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela denies shooting at Trinidad trawler.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela denies shooting at Trinidad trawler.

text.p: Venezuela said on Thursday its navy intercepted a Trinidadian fishing boat in Venezuelan territorial waters but made no mention of a shooting incident reported by Trinidad.

The Defence Ministry said in a statement the Trinidadian boat "Hanna" was caught fishing in Venezuelan waters in the Orinoco delta early on Wednesday and, after "proper warnings," was rammed by a Venezuelan navy vessel, "causing damage near the cabin."

Two Venezuelan navy officers were slightly wounded in the incident, the ministry said. Trinidadian fishermen said the trawler's captain was shot and wounded in an incident Trinidad's Foreign Ministry called "extremely unfortunate."

The president of the Trinidad Trawler Owners Association, Bruno Marharaj, said the captain was shot by a Venezuelan navy boat in the Gulf of Paria as he was operating in Trinidadian territorial waters.

A local fisherman was killed in a similar incident two weeks ago. The gulf separating Trinidad from Venezuela has been a source of conflict between fishermen from the two countries for years. Their governments are discussing security matters and cooperation in patrolling the gulf.
